source.title: dion
source.baseline: Mercenary III research baseline (pinned ST STX)

encoding.codes: four 6-bit codes per three bytes, high bits first; 0 ends; character = code + 31
encoding.centring: start pointer $7232 = buffer - ceil((48 - length) / 2) when length < 48 ($52B0A)
encoding.idHeader: nonzero: terminator becomes a space and ceil((48 - length) / 2) spaces follow ($55B42)
encoding.carryQuirk: after ^2 the next code loses the bits carried from the previous byte ($52978)

liveTokens.[: BCD byte $6EAA, two digits, leading zero suppressed ($529AE)
liveTokens.]: player name $759A, 10 characters, leading/trailing spaces trimmed ($529CC)
liveTokens.^0: BCD byte $6EAB, two digits, leading zero suppressed ($529A6)
liveTokens.^1: low nibble of byte $6E91, one digit ($5299E)
liveTokens.^2: sum of the 26 bytes $6E50,$6E52,...,$6E82 (mod 256), in decimal ($52964, $52978)
liveTokens.^3: low nibble of byte $6ECB, one digit ($52A8C)
